items.name: GB200 NVL72
items.note: 72 颗 Blackwell GPU + 36 颗 Grace CPU，Oberon 机柜，NVLink 72 卡全互联。计算和交换托盘液冷，其余部分仍需风冷。

en.note: 72 Blackwell GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs in an Oberon rack, all 72 GPUs connected by NVLink. Compute and switch trays are liquid-cooled; the rest still needs air cooling.

items.name: GB300 NVL72
items.note: Blackwell Ultra 版本，机柜形态与 GB200 相同，单柜约 132–142 kW。

en.note: Blackwell Ultra version in the same rack form factor as GB200, about 132–142 kW per rack.

items.name: Vera Rubin NVL72
items.note: 72 颗 Rubin GPU + 36 颗 Vera CPU，HBM4 与 NVLink 6，2026 下半年出货。Max-Q 约 190 kW，Max-P 约 230 kW（供应链估算）。

en.note: 72 Rubin GPUs + 36 Vera CPUs with HBM4 and NVLink 6, shipping in the second half of 2026. Max-Q about 190 kW, Max-P about 230 kW (supply chain estimates).

items.name: DGX B200 ×4
items.note: 一柜 4 台 10U DGX B200，每台 8 GPU、约 14.3 kW。纯风冷，单柜接近 60 kW，实际常需背板换热器。

en.note: Four 10U DGX B200 systems per rack, each with 8 GPUs and about 14.3 kW. Air-cooled only and close to 60 kW per rack, so real deployments often need rear-door heat exchangers.

items.name: Rubin Ultra Kyber
items.note: 2027 路线图产品，单柜约 600 kW，全液冷，配电需要 800 VDC 架构。价格为推测值。

en.note: Roadmap product for 2027, about 600 kW per rack, fully liquid-cooled, and needs an 800 VDC power architecture. Price is speculative.

items.name: Quantum-X800 IB
items.note: 800G InfiniBand 交换机柜。简化模型：每柜可接 288 个 GPU 后端网络端口。

en.note: 800G InfiniBand switch rack. Simplified model: each rack provides 288 back-end network ports for GPUs.

items.name: 存储柜
items.note: 全闪存储，承载数据集与检查点。

en.name: Storage rack
en.note: All-flash storage for datasets and checkpoints.

items.name: CDU 冷量分配
items.note: 列间 CDU，把机柜冷板回路接到设施水。每台带走约 800 kW 液冷热量，自身泵耗约 12 kW。

en.name: CDU coolant unit
en.note: In-row coolant distribution unit connecting rack cold-plate loops to facility water. Each removes about 800 kW of liquid-cooling heat, and its pumps draw about 12 kW.

items.name: 列间空调
items.note: 列间风冷单元，每台约 120 kW 显冷量，风机耗电约 9 kW。

en.name: In-row cooler
en.note: In-row air cooling unit with about 120 kW of sensible cooling each; its fans draw about 9 kW.

items.name: 配电柜 RPP
items.note: 远程配电柜，每台可为机柜分配约 800 kW。

en.name: RPP power panel
en.note: Remote power panel; each distributes about 800 kW to racks.
